cards.card_text: A quick side note in the text: back then, someone going to ask God something would say, let's go to the seer.
cards.verse_text: (Formerly in Israel, a man on his way to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.” For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer.)
cards.snippet: …to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.” For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer.)

cards.card_text: Saul and the servant ask them, "Is the seer here?"
cards.verse_text: And as they were climbing the hill to the city, they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”
cards.snippet: …some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”

cards.card_text: Samuel tells Saul he's the seer.
cards.verse_text: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied.
cards.snippet: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied.

cards.card_text: When David gets up in the morning, the word of the LORD has come to Gad the prophet, David's seer.
cards.verse_text: When David got up in the morning, the word of the LORD had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options.

cards.card_text: Yet the LORD warns Israel and Judah through all His prophets and seers.
cards.verse_text: Yet through all His prophets and seers, the LORD warned Israel and Judah, saying, “Turn from your wicked ways and keep My commandments and statutes, according to the entire Law that I commanded your fathers and delivered to you through My servants the prophets.”

cards.card_text: Then come the sons of Heman, the king's seer: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel and on down to Mahazioth.
cards.verse_text: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

cards.card_text: Shelomith and his brothers also look after everything dedicated by Samuel the seer, by Saul son of Kish, Israel's first king, and by two army commanders: Abner son of Ner, who served Saul (1 Samuel 14:50), and Joab son of Zeruiah, who served David (2 Samuel 8:16).
cards.verse_text: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.

cards.card_text: Everything King David did, first to last, is written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, Nathan the Prophet and Gad the Seer.
cards.verse_text: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer, together with all the details of his reign, his might, and the circumstances that came upon him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the lands.
cards.snippet: …first to last, are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the…

cards.card_text: The rest of Solomon's acts, from beginning to end, are written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat, a man who served Solomon (1 Kings 11:26).
cards.verse_text: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, in the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
cards.snippet: …Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

cards.card_text: Everything Rehoboam did, first to last, is written in the records of Shemaiah the Prophet and Iddo the Seer.
cards.verse_text: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the Prophet and of Iddo the Seer concerning the genealogies?
cards.snippet: …written in the records of Shemaiah the Prophet and of Iddo the Seer concerning the genealogies?

cards.verse_text: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him, “Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

cards.verse_text: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD?

cards.card_text: Then Hezekiah stations the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps and lyres, by the command of David, of Gad the king's seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.verse_text: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.snippet: …and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet.

cards.card_text: Hezekiah and his officials order the Levites to sing praises in the words of David and of Asaph the seer.
cards.verse_text: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer.
cards.snippet: …to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer.

cards.card_text: The rest of Manasseh's acts, with his prayer and the words of the seers who spoke to him, are written in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
cards.verse_text: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, they are indeed written in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
cards.snippet: …along with his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God…

cards.card_text: The Records of the Seers keep his prayer too, along with all his sin.
cards.verse_text: His prayer and how God received his plea, as well as all his sin and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself, they are indeed written in the Records of the Seers.
cards.snippet: …he humbled himself, they are indeed written in the Records of the Seers.

cards.card_text: The prophets and seers The kings and princes The farmers and shepherds
cards.verse_text: He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.
cards.snippet: …has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.

cards.card_text: Then they hand the seers an order of their own: “Stop seeing visions!”
cards.verse_text: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth!
cards.snippet: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us…

cards.card_text: Then Amaziah turns to Amos himself: "Go away, you seer!" No hello, no how was the trip, just GO.
cards.verse_text: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer!
cards.snippet: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer!

cards.card_text: Once the visions are gone, the seers and diviners are honored for their honesty.
cards.verse_text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.
cards.snippet: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.

cards.card_text: The seers and diviners all end up covering their mouths.
